name: task-manager
description: Open-source collaborative task and sprint manager

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @task-manager/api && npm run build --workspace @task-manager/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @task-manager/api" "npm run dev --workspace @task-manager/web"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @task-manager/api && npm run lint --workspace @task-manager/web
scripts.prisma:deploy:docker: docker compose run --rm --entrypoint npx -v ./packages/database/prisma:/app/packages/database/prisma:ro api prisma migrate deploy --schema packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @task-manager/api && npm run test --workspace @task-manager/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @task-manager/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @task-manager/web
